summary.text: Dan Osman is a Democratic state representative who has represented Kansas House District 48 since 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. An attorney, he is the ranking minority member of the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Osman earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-Madison and a J.D. from the University of Kansas School of Law.
His career experience includes working as an attorney and as a school board director of the Hickman Mills School District.
Osman was appointed to the Kansas House on July 8, 2021, to replace Representative Jennifer Day, who had resigned in June of that year, and he assumed office on August 2, 2021.

During the 2025-2026 session he served on the Commerce, Labor and Economic Development, House Federal and State Affairs, Rules and Journal, and Fiduciary Financial Institutions Oversight committees, and as ranking minority member of the House Judiciary Committee.
